common.c,s: unit direction of C (c²+s²=1); often c≥s>0
common.h or η: h=s/(1+c) half-angle proxy; η same family
common.l,r,u,d: C actual axis extents (left,right,up,down) from O
common.h_C: C horizontal chord length through relevant height
common.J,H,D,A: RIGHT/TOP free chord and complementary segments
common.F: free block (bottom mid, often); F∩H = F horizontal intersection
common.W: free corner / original V3 in far notation
common.rho, ρ: R33 density/angle bound function of a
common.f: F horizontal chord length when nonempty

per_frame_poses.R32_right_pos: RIGHT gap positive; LEFT meet; F H status per M3; C avoids TOP/BOTTOM when F H nonempty
per_frame_poses.R33_right_ne: RIGHT nonempty branch; uses z+q(u), Σ, Φ(w)
per_frame_poses.R37_empty_left: F H empty + LEFT; axis extents in [μ-1,2-μ]; Σ>(1-d)²
per_frame_poses.R38_empty_right: F H empty + RIGHT; L2>1+w; e+d<G
per_frame_poses.R39_contact: single contact → last standard form; Σ>2-√2; η,K,u,r caps
